spec.description: Every store, top-down: Qdrant (catalog vectors), Redis (app cache, Langfuse queue), Langfuse's Postgres, ClickHouse and MinIO, and DynamoDB-local (chat history).

spec.title: Vectors
spec.description: Across all collections: the product catalog and the semantic answer cache.

spec.title: Redis memory
spec.description: The app cache: answers, embeddings, budgets, rate limits.

spec.title: PG conns
spec.description: Langfuse's open connections to its metadata database.

spec.title: DynamoDB
spec.description: DynamoDB-local has no metrics endpoint: a TCP probe says whether it is up.

spec.title: Failed (1h)
spec.description: Requests Qdrant answered with an error.

spec.title: REST calls/s by endpoint
spec.description: Each search the API makes shows up here.

spec.title: Up
spec.description: Can the exporter talk to this Redis?

spec.title: Hit ratio
spec.description: Lookups that found their key (15 min).

spec.title: AOF writes
spec.description: Last append-only-file write. Data survives a restart only while this is OK.

spec.title: Evicted (1h)
spec.description: Keys thrown out because memory was full. Non-zero means the cache is too small for its data.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Used by data vs held from the OS.

spec.title: Average latency by command
spec.description: Time Redis spends per call, slowest six commands.

spec.title: Keys expired and evicted/s
spec.description: Expired = TTL reached (normal). Evicted = memory full.

spec.title: Connections received and rejected/s
spec.description: Rejected connections mean maxclients was reached.

spec.description: How long a TCP connect takes. In-memory store: a restart empties it, by design.
